{{Quote|You're outmanned, laserblade.|translated=1|Embo, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Bounty Hunters" />}}
'''Embo''' was a [[Kyuzo]] [[Gender|male]] [[bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Republic Era|era]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. Embo carried a [[bowcaster]] and wore a large-rimmed circular [[Kyuzo war shield|hat]], which he used as a weapon or a shield. Even as a capable solo hunter, he worked with several different groups throughout the Clone Wars. Embo was known to work as part of [[Sugi (bounty hunter)|Sugi's]] [[Sugi's bounty hunters|band]] of [[bounty]] hunters in particular. On [[Felucia]], Embo worked with Sugi's crew [[Skirmish on Felucia|to defend]] a group of [[Felucian]] farmers from the [[Ohnaka Gang]]. On another occasions, he encountred the members of [[Clone Force 99]] who were [[Hunt for a thief|pursuing]] a masked [[Asajj Ventress]] who had stolen a list of undercover Republic [[Ghost Agent]]s and fought her. Later, he worked for the [[Hutt Clan]]s, battling against the former [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]] and his [[Shadow Collective]]. Embo was also a member of [[Boba Fett]]'s [[Krayt's Claw]], working alongside hunters such as [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]], [[C-21 Highsinger]], and [[Latts Razzi]]. At one point, the group were hired by Asajj Ventress to help her break out her lover [[Quinlan Vos]] from [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s [[Castle Serenno|castle]] on [[Serenno]]. On [[Scipio]], he managed to briefly match the legendary [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] in combat. He also owned a pet [[anooba]] named [[Marrok (anooba)|Marrok]] and a saucer-shaped [[starship]] called the [[Guillotine (starship)|''Guillotine'']].

During the [[Imperial Era]], Embo was hired by [[Mercurial Swift]] to capture Sugi's niece, [[Jas Emari]]. He worked alongside [[Dengar]] and [[Jeeta]] to accomplish this, but later joined [[Jas Emari's crew|Emari's crew]]. After the [[Battle of Jakku]], Embo received funding from the [[New Republic]], but when it ran out, he lived as a [[farmer]] on [[Felucia]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Embo was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Phatrong]].<ref name="Embo" /> During the [[Clone Wars]], Embo was working as a [[bounty hunter]]. Embo was often a part of [[Sugi (bounty hunter)|Sugi's]] [[Sugi's bounty hunters|band of bounty hunters]], alongside [[Rumi Paramita]] and [[Seripas]].<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> Embo and Sugi came to be relatively close,<ref name="Empire's End" /> and Sugi often relied on Embo as a favored mercenary.<ref name="Collapse">''[[Collapse of the Republic]]''</ref> Embo also cooparated with the [[Duros]] bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]], but managed to establish an own reputation as an elite hunter.<ref name="Secrets of the Bounty Hunters">''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
====Battle on Felucia====
[[File:EmboBowcaster.png|thumb|left|250px|Embo prepares to take out a Weequay pirate.]]
During the Clone Wars, the crew was employed by<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> [[Casiss Midagatis]],<ref name="TCW CE" /> the leader of the [[farm]]ing village [[Akira]] on the [[planet]] [[Felucia]], to protect the villagers and their harvest of the medical herb [[nysillin]] from a [[Ohnaka Gang|gang]] of [[pirate]]s led by [[Hondo Ohnaka]]. Shortly after they had been hired, the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano]] crash-landed on Felucia and discovered the village. A brief standoff between the Jedi and the hunters took place before Casiss intervened, begging the two groups to work together against the pirates.<ref name="Bounty Hunters" />

The Jedi were initially reluctant to help the villagers, but were swayed after a brief encounter with Ohnaka, the leader of the gang, whom the Jedi had met [[Mission to Florrum|once before]]. Refusing to be bought off by the pirates, the bounty hunters, along with the Jedi, began teaching the villagers to defend themselves. Embo, watching Skywalker train the villagers how to use a simple farming tool as a weapon, chuckled at their lack of experience. While the villagers were preparing to [[Skirmish on Felucia|fight]], Sugi spotted a lone pirate watching from a nearby ridge. Embo was sent to deal with the [[scout]] and the [[Kyuzo]] quickly took him out, disabling his [[Starhawk speeder bike]] with his [[bowcaster]] and blocking the pirate's shots using his [[Kyuzo war shield|metallic hat]], before snapping the [[Weequay]]'s neck with his bare hands. Skywalker commended Embo for his actions, but the fact that the scout would no longer check back in with Hondo meant the villagers did not have any [[time]] to waste.<ref name="Bounty Hunters" />

[[File:Embo_hurt.png|thumb|right|250px|Embo lies wounded.]]
Soon afterwards, the pirates attacked the village. Dozens of pirates on [[speeder bike]]s swept into the village, firing at the defenders. Embo dispatched one of the pirates and commandeered a [[speeder]] bike, using it to take out several others. However, when Ohnaka arrived on the scene in his [[WLO-5 speeder tank]].<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> Wary of the Kyuzo's natural athletic abilities, Ohnaka chose to shoot at Embo from a distance with his [[tank]]<ref name="Secrets of the Bounty Hunters">''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> and the bounty hunter was not quick enough to avoid one of the tank's blasts and was hit. With a badly wounded right arm, Embo was helped into the main barn at the center of the village by Sugi and the others, unable to participate in the battle any longer. After Ohnaka and his pirates retreated and fled the [[Felucia system|system]], Embo left in Sugi's [[Starship|ship]], the ''[[Halo]]'', along with the Jedi, and traveled to a [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] outpost.<ref name="Bounty Hunters" />

====Freelancing====
{{Quote|He understands you, Hunter. First of all, he says his name is Embo. As for your dead bodies threat, he says that can be arranged.|[[Tech]] translating Embo's words to Hunter on Doric Prime|<ref name="HS:TBB:GA 4">[[Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents 4|''Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents'' 4]]</ref>}}
[[File:EmboMarrok-Revenge.png|thumb|left|Embo with Marrok during the Clone Wars|217x217px]]
At one point in [[21 BBY]],<ref name="SoP Date">{{TCWcanondates|304}}</ref>, Embo and Sugi, were present at the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] on [[Tatooine]]. While they were there, [[Pantoran]] [[diplomat]]s [[Notluwiski Papanoida|Papanoida]] and his son, [[Ion Papanoida|Ion]], were searching for [[Greedo]], a [[Rodian]] bounty hunter that had [[Kidnapping of the Papanoida daughters|kidnapped]] Papanoida's daughters.<ref name="Sphere of Influence">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>

At some point between 21 and [[20 BBY]],<ref name="HSDate">According to ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'', the name "[[Clone Force 99]]" came in honor of the [[Death|deceased]] [[Clone 99]], who died during the [[Battle of Kamino]] in [[21 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. As the name "Clone Force 99" is used on [[Wrecker's helmet]] in [[Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents 1|''Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents'' 1]], the series must take place after the Battle of Kamino. The story is also set while [[Asajj Ventress]] is a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]], placing it before the [[Battle of Sullust]], dated to [[20 BBY]] according to ''Timelines''. As such, ''[[Star Wars: Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents]]'' must be set between 21 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 20 BBY.</ref> Embo was present on the Galactic Republic's [[capital]] planet [[Coruscant]] with his pet [[anooba]] [[Marrok (anooba)|Marrok]]. At the same time, the Republic [[clone commando]]s of [[Clone Force 99]] [[Hunt for a thief|pursued]] the masked<ref name="HS:TBB:GA 1">[[Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents 1|''Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents'' 1]]</ref> [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] agent [[Asajj Ventress]]<ref name="HS:TBB:GA 3">[[Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents 3|''Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents'' 3]]</ref> who had stolen a list of undercover Republic [[Ghost Agent]]s. While the clones tried to stop the thief from boarding [[Unidentified spice ship|a spice ship]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld]], Embo attaked the clones with his hat and electro shocks and told them in Kyuzon that he knew that they were after something valuable and that he had decided to aquire it first. He then shot at the four using his bowcaster while Marrok attacked the squad's leader [[Sergeant]] [[Hunter]], before he and his pet boarded his starship<ref name="HS:TBB:GA 1" /> the [[Guillotine (starship)|''Guillotine'']].<ref name="Dark Disciple" /> Both groups managed to follow the spice ship to a [[Pyke Syndicate]] base on [[Kessel]]. There, the two competing teams once again came into brief conflict before Embo and Marrok managed to catch up with the thief. The [[Dark Acolyte]] however, used [[the Force]] and [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers|her lightsabers]] to defend herself and managed to once again flee on [[Asajj Ventress' ship|a starship]]<ref name="HS:TBB:GA 2">[[Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents 2|''Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Ghost Agents'' 2]]</ref> to [[Doric Prime]] where she met up with the bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing]].<ref name="HS:TBB:GA 3" /> In the [[Doric Prime power plant]], the clones again encountered Embo who demanded to know what they were after and the teams again exchanged blaster fire. Clone commando [[Wrecker]] almost managed to pin down the Kyuzo, but he managed to shoot a pipe which flooded the room with water. Embo offered to pick the lock of a release valve in the ceiling of the quickly flooding room and both him and the clone troopers managed to escape. Outside, [[Crosshair]] threatened the bounty hunter, but Hunter offered for them to partner up with Embo receiving some credits from the clones. The five then used a group of [[Unidentified sea creature|local sea creatures]] to ride back to the landing platform with both of their ships. There the clones encountred Ventress and Sing and initially assumed that Embo had betrayed them, but he and Marrok came back to attack Ventress. The [[Dark side of the Force|dark sider]] manged to catch his war shield in the air and fend off Marrok while the clones boarded [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|their shuttle]] to pursue Sing and left Embo behind, who reminded them of their deal. While his team members told him that Embo could fend for himself, Hunter had trouble leaving him with Ventress and before she could almost manage to kill Embo, Hunter shot the lightsaber from her hand to help him.<ref name="HS:TBB:GA 4" />

Later on in 20 BBY,<ref name="TheBox-Date">{{TCWcanondates|417}}</ref> Embo was present on [[Serenno]] with eleven other bounty hunters, including Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi who was disguised as the [[Concord Dawn|Concordian]] bounty hunter [[Rako Hardeen]], to fight in the "[[Box]]," which had been designed by [[Moralo Eval]]. Embo was one of the few hunters to survive the [[Tournament on Serenno|challenge]], and was assigned by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref> Embo then traveled to [[Naboo]] with the group, led by Cad Bane, to carry out the daring mission. The hunters successfully [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine|kidnapped]] the Chancellor, assuming the roles of [[Senate Commando]]s through the use of the [[holographic disguise matrix]], developed by [[Sinrich]]. Embo rushed the Chancellor away but failed to escape and were arrested by Skywalker and [[Mace Windu]].<ref name="Crisis on Naboo" />

Embo did not remain in Republic custody for long, however, and<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref> some time later that year,<ref name="Bounty-Date">{{TCWcanondates|420}}</ref> he along with Marrok were seen sharing a table at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] on Tatooine, while the pair were also present outside a hut in the town while Asajj Ventress met the members of [[Boba Fett]]'s team of bounty hunters,<ref name="Bounty" /> [[Krayt's Claw]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy">''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]''</ref>

====Employed by the Hutts====
[[File:BountyHunterTableDance-Eminence.png|thumb|right|250px|Embo prepares to defend his employers.]]
Some time later, Embo was employed by the [[Grand Hutt Council]] as a [[bodyguard]], along with Sugi, [[Dengar]], and [[Latts Razzi]]. When [[Maul]] and his brother, [[Savage Opress]], representing the [[Shadow Collective]], [[Mission to Nal Hutta|threatened]] the [[Hutt Clan|Hutts]], Embo and the others sprang into action to defend their employers. At first the bounty hunters were able to beat the brothers back, but they were driven back when the forces of [[Death Watch]] joined in the attack. Embo went up against Opress on his own, saved from the Zabrak only by the strength of his hat. When it was clear that they could not defeat the two brothers, Embo and the others retreated, abandoning their employers.<ref name="Eminence" />

====Targeting Clovis====
[[File:EmboCallsSid-AOF.png|thumb|left|220px|Embo reports his success to Darth Sidious.]]
Sometime after, Embo [[Mission to Scipio|traveled]] to [[Scipio]], the home planet of [[Rush Clovis]], whom he had been hired to drive off the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]] vault world. Embo tracked [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] with a [[probe droid]] and killed Amidala's [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|aide]], [[Teckla Minnau]] when his probe droid spotted her planting a [[thermal detonator]] in the [[power generator]] superstructure. The Kyuzo then began to surveil Clovis' quarters, and when Clovis arrived along with Amidala and Skywalker, Embo disabled the trio's ship. As they fled in a speeder, Marrok forced them to pilot down the mountainside. Embo used his hat to sled down the mountain in pursuit of the speeder carrying his target. However, he was held at bay by Skywalker until the trio was saved by [[R2-D2]], who was [[pilot]]ing their [[T-6 shuttle|ship]], saving them before they could go over a cliff. Having accomplished his mission, Embo informed his employer, [[Darth]] Sidious, that Clovis had escaped—just as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Dark Lord]] had planned.<ref name="An Old Friend">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref> The story of how Embo sled down the mountain on Scipio in pursuit of a target came eventually to be heard by Hondo Ohnaka.<ref name="Secrets of the Bounty Hunters" />

====Krayt's Claw====
In the latter [[Standard month|months]] of the war, Embo began taking jobs on a regular basis with Boba Fett's team, Krayt's Claw. One job in particular found the crew hired by former ally of the [[Sith]], Asajj Ventress, to assist in the rescue of her lover, [[Quinlan Vos]], from his captivity on Serenno. This was his first time working with the [[Dathomirian]] [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] and former [[Sith apprentice]]. Embo and his anooba Marrok traveled to Serenno on the ''Guillotine'' and rendezvoused with ''Krayt's Claw'' and Ventress at the planet's [[spaceport]]. While the [[Mission to Serenno (Krayt's Claw)|mission]] proved to be a failure, Embo and the rest of Fett's team escaped a direct encounter with the [[Sith Lord]] Count Dooku, alive.<ref name="Dark Disciple" />

===Reign of the Empire===
{{Quote|…But in the end, he was out of his league before he even tried getting the jump on me. It's just too bad he couldn't tell you about it himself.|Lando Calrissian exaggerating his defeat of Embo to Nien Nunb|<ref name="Home Again">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=16|story=Flight of the Falcon, Part 3: Home Again}}</ref>}}
In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="FighterFlightDate">{{RebelsDate|104}}</ref> Embo and Cad Bane were depicted in some [[graffiti]] art by [[Sabine Wren]], aboard the ''[[Ghost]]'', the ship of [[Hera Syndulla]].<ref name="Fighter Flight">{{Rebels|Fighter Flight}}</ref>

Around [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Long Game date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[The Long Game (comic story)|The Long Game]]" to around [[2 BBY]].</ref> Embo joined his fellow bounty hunters [[IG-88B|IG-88]], [[4-LOM]], Dengar, and [[Krrsantan]] to investigate a jailbreak on [[Kalarassi Five]] for the [[Galactic Empire]]. There, [[Kaluub Akjee]], one of the escaped prisoners, and his fellow escapees had disguised themselves as [[stormtrooper]]s. Akjee told Embo and the others that wanted criminal [[Venga Liss]] had broken in, taken the prisoners, and headed for the slums, urging them to go while they could still catch him. Embo and the other bounty hunters, unaware that Akjee wasn't a stormtrooper, followed Akjee's direction and ran off toward the slums, but IG-88 stayed behind and discovered Akjee's true identity.<ref name="Long Game">{{StoryCite|story=The Long Game (comic story)|book=Age of Rebellion Special 1}}</ref>

[[File:Embo_and_Lando.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Embo encounters Lando Calrissian.]]
Following the Battle of Endor, Embo took on a job to collect a bounty placed on [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], a prominent general in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who had been responsible for the destruction of the Galactic Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]]. Embo located Lando's ship, the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', at a refueling station and snuck onboard the vessel. The stowaway Embo sabotaged the ship, keeping it from taking liftoff. While Calrissian was attempting to conduct repairs, Embo cornered him with his bowcaster. Embo spoke to him, though Lando could only understand the words "Death Star" come from the Kyuzo. Lando realized that Embo was there to collect the bounty on him and tried to offer Embo a deal that involved splitting the bounty. Embo protested and aimed his blaster, but Lando stalled long enough for one of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} pipes to burst behind Embo, knocking the hunter into a wall and incapacitating him. While Embo got his bearings, he was tied up by Calrissian. Lando brought the captive Embo outside the ship, where he exaggerated what had happened to his co-pilot, [[Nien Nunb]]. Lando had also managed to complete repairs on the ship, and credited an [[L3-37|old friend]] inside the ''Falcon'' for helping him stop Embo.<ref name="Home Again" />

===Jakku===
In 5 ABY,<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Embo, along with the bounty hunters Dengar and a [[Rodian]] named [[Jeeta]], was hired by [[Mercurial Swift]] in order to capture [[Jas Emari]], Sugi's niece. The [[Black Sun]] crime [[boss]] [[Gyuti]] had imposed a [[bounty]] on Emari's head. Embo joined Swift's party because he wanted to clear his debts. After learning that [[Niima]] the Hutt had taken Jas captive on [[Jakku]], Embo and the other bounty hunters traveled to [[Niima's temple]] to pick her up. Swift went into Emari's cell to fetch her, intending to collect the bounty for himself and abandon his crew. However, Jas broke free and overpowered her captors.<ref name="Empire's End" />

After escaping her captors, Jas headed to the [[hangar]] only to find Embo and Dengar guarding Swift's [[Corellian shuttle]]. They began speaking, and during the conversation Embo mentioned the [[death]] of Marrok, which had happened years before. Knowing that Embo had incurred debts, Jas tried to remind Embo that he and her aunt Sugi had worked together. Emari convinced Embo to let her take the ship, saying that he was old and that Marrok always liked her. Dengar tried to stop Jas but she managed to escape on the Corellian [[shuttle]].<ref name="Empire's End" />

Later, Jas Emari and the [[New Republic]] operative [[Norra Wexley]] returned to Niima's temple. In return for ferrying Niima back to her temple, the Hutt crime lady had outfitted them with an old [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] shuttle, old [[Clothing|uniforms]], and clearance codes to enter the [[Main Imperial base]] on Jakku. Embo and the rest of Swift's party cornered Jas and Niima. While Norra escaped with her [[Temmin Wexley|son's]] [[droid]] [[Mister Bones]] aboard the shuttle, Jas stayed behind in order to allow Norra to proceed with her mission to capture [[Grand Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]].<ref name="Empire's End" />

Following Emari's capture, Swift attempted to travel to [[Nar Shaddaa]] to deliver Jas to Boss Gyuti. However, they were unable to leave due to the [[Battle of Jakku]]. During the wait, Jas managed to convince Embo, Dengar, and Jeeta to turn against Swift. She offered to secure them pardons from the New Republic if they switched sides. Swift tried to object but was thrown out of the shuttle by Jas with the help of Dengar. Embo, Jeeta, and Dengar then became [[Jas Emari's crew|Jas' crew]]. They took Swift's shuttle to the [[Jakku Observatory]] where they picked up Norra, who had joined forces with Sloane and her estranged [[Marriage|husband]] [[Brentin Lore Wexley]] to stop [[Gallius Rax]] from destroying Jakku as part of the late [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor's]] [[contingency]] plan.<ref name="Empire's End" />

===After the Battle of Jakku===
Following the Battle of Jakku and the [[Galactic Concordance]], Embo and the rest of Emari's crew received full pardons from the New Republic with the help of Jas' friend [[Sinjir Rath Velus]], a former Imperial [[loyalty officer]] who had become an [[Advisor|adviser]] to [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]]. They also received enough [[Currency|money]] from the New Republic and continued to work with Emari as her crew.<ref name="Empire's End" />

In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Secrets of the Bounty Hunters Date">''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters]]'' establishes that the in-universe book was written after the [[war against the Pykes]], but before the [[statue of IG-11]] was taken down in "[[Chapter 17: The Apostate]]." ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the war against the [[Pyke]]s to [[9 ABY]], and "Chapter 17: The Apostate" takes place in 9 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:MandoDate|here]]. Therefore, ''The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters'' must have been created in that [[Standard year|year]] as well.</ref> Hondo Ohnaka mentioned Embo and various other bounty hunters in his book ''[[The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters]]''. In it, Ohnaka talked about his interaction with Embo on Felucia and how they gave him a negative opinion of the bounty hunter and theorized that Embo had still not forgotten or forgiven his attack on him during the battle.<ref name="Secrets of the Bounty Hunters" />

===Encountering Grogu===
[[File:Embo-TheMandalorianandGroguTrailer.png|thumb|right|250px|Embo on a rainy location during the early New Republic Era]]
During the early [[New Republic Era]], Embo and an anooba approached the youngling [[Grogu]] and a group of [[Anzellan]]s on a rainy location.<ref name="TMaG Trailer2">{{SWYouTube|IHWlvwu8t1w|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22}}</ref>

===Meeting with Bazine Netal===
{{Quote|You encountered the ''Millennium Falcon''—tell me about it. Deal?|Bazine Netal, to Embo|<ref name="Home Again" />}}
By 9 ABY,<ref name="Hunters Date">The description of [[Imara Vex]]'s costume "[[Embo Bounty Hunter]]" from ''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]'' states that Embo had retired as a [[farmer]] on [[Felucia]], placing his retirement by [[9 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:HuntersDate|here]].</ref> the New Republic funding Embo had received ran dry and he informally retired from bounty hunting. Embo chose Felucia to settle on due to its value to him, starting a life as a farmer there.<ref name="Home Again" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Home Again">The events of [[Star Wars Adventures, Volume 6: Flight of the Falcon|Flight of the Falcon]] takes place while the [[Resistance]] is on [[Batuu]], which ''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' dates to 34 [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|ASW4]], which corresponds to [[34 ABY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> Embo was sought out by mercenary [[Bazine Netal]], who was searching for the whereabouts of the ''Millennium Falcon.'' Netal learned from [[Monster droid|junk droid]] [[Teetee]] that a bounty hunter who once owned a pet anooba and an armored hat had been in contact with the ''Falcon,'' and she immediately recognized who the droid was referring to.<ref name="Misfit Droids">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=15|story=Flight of the Falcon, Part 2: The Planet of Misfit Droids}}</ref> Netal found Embo on Felucia, though the Kyuzo reacted poorly to her arrival and, after a short chase, he cornered her and she offered him a deal. Netal knew that he was low on credits and offered him some in exchange for information on his encounter with the ''Falcon.'' Despite the initial language barrier, Embo told her the story of his failed attempt to capture the ship and collect the bounty on Lando Calrissian's head after the Battle of Endor. Netal was underwhelmed with the story and did not believe it was worth the credits, but held up her end of the bargain. As she prepared to make her leave, Embo gave her what information he had on the current location of the ship. He told her that it had surfaced on [[Corellia]], and directed Netal to meet with<ref name="Home Again" /> [[Lady]] [[Proxima]]<ref name="Lady and the Tramp">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=17|story=Flight of the Falcon, Part 4: Lady and the Tramp}}</ref> to find out more.<ref name="Home Again" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Well, whoever's said you've lost your step is ''wrong.'' Bounty hunter, ''farmer''- whatever you want to call yourself, you're every bit as dangerous as I would have hoped... Embo.|Bazine Netal|<ref name="Home Again" />}}
[[File:TrackingTheQuarry-ND.png|thumb|left|250px|Embo and Marrok track their quarry.]]
Embo was a quiet, stoic, and disciplined individual, speaking only in [[Kyuzo (language)|his native language]],<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> which made it difficult for others to understand him. He was also mostly ruthless, dispatching foe after foe without mercy or remorse (although he did feel remorse for accepting a bounty on Jas Emari, as he was unwilling to hurt her), and using his unorthodox weapons to lethal effect.<ref name="An Old Friend" /> Embo had no code beyond getting paid.<ref name="TCW CE" />

Although commonly freelance, Embo was a constant and reliable ally of Sugi, who could always count on him to show up when she needed him.<ref name="Collapse" /> Embo was also respected by her niece Jas Emari. Having incurred debts by the time of the Battle of Jakku, Embo reluctantly accepted an offer from Mercurial Swift to join his crew and collect Boss Gyuti's bounty on Jas. However, Embo was unwilling to hurt Jas since they had worked together in the past. On one occasion, he allowed Jas to escape. On another, he and his fellow bounty hunters Dengar and Jeeta turned against Swift after Jas convinced them to join forces with her in return for securing pardons from the New Republic. Due to their dislike for Swift, Embo did not object to Dengar and Jas throwing Swift out of his shuttle.<ref name="Empire's End" />

Hailing from the planet [[Phatrong]], Embo was a hulking<ref name="TCW CE" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Embo" /> Kyuzo who stood at 1.99 [[meter]]s, or 6 feet, 6 inches.<ref name="TCW CE" /> He had [[Color|orange]] [[eye]]s and green skin.<ref name="Kyuzo" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Embo, your bounty tallies were second only to one last season.|Dooku to Embo|<ref name="The Box" />}}
[[File:Embo-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|right|300px|Embo, equipped with his bowcaster]]
A deadly fighter, Embo was skilled in a variety of areas. Extremely acrobatic and agile, Embo could jump very high and run faster than any [[human]],<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> while his proficiency in [[unarmed combat]] made him the equal of any Jedi or Sith when it came to close-quarters fighting. Although in his fight with Savage, Embo only survived thanks to the strength of his hat.<ref name="Eminence" /> Embo was very skilled with his chosen weapons, using his rimmed hat to take out opponents from a distance and also use as a shield. Embo was also a good shot with his bowcaster,<ref name="An Old Friend" /> and was a capable [[sniper]]. He was also an expert tracker.<ref name="TCW CE" /> Hondo Ohnaka assumed that Embo's preferance lied in hand-to-hand combat where he could use his species' natural agility to his advantage.<ref name="Secrets of the Bounty Hunters" /> His many missions during the Clone Wars, led him to be considered as among the upper echelons of the bounty hunters profession<ref name="Secrets of the Bounty Hunters" /> and at one point in the War, Embo was considered second only to Cad Bane in the entire [[The galaxy|galaxy]].<ref name="The Box" /> Bane personally held himself in higher regard but also respected Embo's ability.<ref name="Bane's Story">{{StoryCite|story=Bane's Story|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark}}</ref> Embo was skilled in sabotage, able to tamper with the ''Millennium Falcon'' and prevent it from taking off.<ref name="Home Again" /> Embo was also very effective in infiltrations.<ref name="TCW CE" />

==Equipment==
[[File:GuillotineStarship-TBBGhostAgents4.png|thumb|Embo's starship the ''Guillotine''|left|200x200px]]
{{Quote|Embo was one of the greatest bounty hunters of all time. Also one of the most efficient - he used his hat as a weapon AND a shield!|[[Imara Vex]]|<ref name="Hunters">''[[Star Wars: Hunters]]''</ref>}}
Unlike bounty hunters such as Cad Bane or [[Jango Fett]], Embo relied little on technology. Embo's primary weapons were a bowcaster that can easily fold away for travel and his unique metallic, wide-rimmed hat, which doubled as a shield and as a throwing weapon. During the Clone Wars, Embo often wore a chest plate, with an ammunition [[bandolier]] slung over his shoulder, and wore a long [[Color|red]] fighting skirt decorated with gold symbols.<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> Embo once used [[macrobinoculars]], an [[imagecaster]], and a hovering, single-eyed [[probe droid]].<ref name="An Old Friend" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So Embo's out there now. Who knows what Embo's future gonna be. He's got a cool hat. Maybe Embo likes wolves too. We have to see.|Dave Filoni in the StarWars.com episode feature for "Bounty Hunters"|<ref name="BH Featurette">{{SW|url=video/bounty-hunters-episode-featurette|text="Bounty Hunters" Episode Featurette}}</ref>}}
Embo first appeared in the seventeenth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' titled "[[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]]", that first aired in early [[2010]]. He was voiced by supervising director [[Dave Filoni]].<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> 

Embo was designed by [[Pat Presley]], with concept art finished on [[October 8]],<ref name="Insider 117">{{InsiderCite|117|Star Wars: The Unusual Suspects|''Star Wars'': The Unusual Suspects|reprint=1}}</ref> [[2008]].<ref name="Presley IG">{{Instagram|username=phattro|name=[[Pat Presley]]|url=p/DU3-GbuklzV|date=2026-02-17|quote=I couldn’t believe my own eyes! 😮 Embo showed up on the Mandalorian & Grogu trailer that came out this morning! Ever since I designed this bad MF back in '08 for The Clone Wars Season 2, I've always been wondering if he'd ever make an appearance in live-action SW. Wonder no more. The Kyuzo bounty hunter is ready 4 action. What a pleasant surprise to see him in the trailer. Cheers!|archivefile=File:PatPresley-EmboReturn-Instagram.png}} {{C|Comment by [[Patrick Beals]]: "👏👏👏 I think they put him in the rain deliberately with that hat! 😂. I got to design some of his gear for the movie!"}}</ref> Presley also designed his heavy bowcaster, which he finished the same day.<ref name="Bounty Hunters EG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/bounty-hunters-episode-guide|text="Bounty Hunters" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> The character's design was based on unused concept art for a [[Neimoidian]] warrior with a breathing mask created by [[Sang Jun Lee]] for the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace]]''<ref name="Recycled">{{SW|url=news/back-from-the-drawing-board-recycled-star-wars-aliens|text=Back from the Drawing Board: Recycled ''Star Wars'' Aliens|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref> that was given to the production crew by ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] and was only slightly modified for the series.<ref name="Insider 117" /> Embo was first ever publicly pictured in July [[2009]] during that year's [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic-Con]]<ref name="Comic-Con">{{OfficialBlog|url=2009/07/21/lucasfilm-pavilion-at-comic-con-first-pics|text=Comic-Con First Pics: Rise of the ''Star Wars'' Pavilion}}</ref> and Presley's concept art was revealed that September.<ref name="Concept reveal">{{OfficialBlog|url=2009/09/24/clone-wars-season-2-bounty-hunters|text=''Clone Wars'' Season 2: Bounty Hunters}}</ref> The character's alien language, was devised by Filoni and is actually a purposefully badly enunciated version of the ''[[Wikipedia:Smurfs|Smurfs]]'' books, written in [[Wikipedia:French|French]], which belonged to editor [[Nic Anastassiou]] who kept them in the office to read to his son. Filoni was originally hesitant to voice a character in the show and kept it a secret from most of the crew.<ref name="BH Featurette" /> Some of Embo's dialogue was presented in English in the episode's script.<ref name="Bounty Hunters EG" /> At the time, he was one of only few alien language speaking characters in the series at that time due to problems with subtitling and the creators worked around the problem by having other characters like react to his words in regular Basic, with Filoni comparing him to [[R2-D2]].<ref name="Insider 117" /> Embo's species, the Kyuzo,<ref name="Bounty Hunters EG" /> share their name with the character Kyūzō, played by [[Wikipedia:Seiji Miyaguchi|Seiji Miyaguchi]], in the film [[Wikipedia:Seven Samurai|''Seven Samurai'']] by [[Wikipedia:Akira Kurosawa|Akira Kurosawa]],<ref name="Seven Samurai">[[Wikipedia:Seven Samurai|''Seven Samurai'']]</ref> to which the episode is dedicated.<ref name="Bounty Hunters EG" /> The character was originally intended to be killed off at the end of "Bounty Hunters." However, after discussion about the character among the production team who felt that he was a "cool" character, they decided to have him injured by Hondo but survive, as seen in the final version and redid the scene.<ref name="BH Featurette" /> The unfinished version can be seen from the behind-the-scenes clips about the season included in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|DVD and Blu-ray releases]].

In the in the episode featurette on [[StarWars.com]] for "Bounty Hunters", Filoni pondered the possibility for that Embo would like wolves too.<ref name="BH Featurette" /> The character then later appeared with a pet anooba named Marrok in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|season four]] episode "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]" in [[2012]].<ref name="Bounty" /> A sketch of Embo and Marrok was drawn by Filoni and he has likened the relationship between Marrok and Embo to that of the ''[[Wikipedia:G.I. Joe|G.I. Joe]]'' characters [[Wikipedia:Snake Eyes (G.I. Joe)|Snake Eyes]] and Timber.<ref name="Insider 134">{{InsiderCite|134|Behind and Beyond the Battle Lines}}</ref>

Before the cancellation of ''The Clone Wars'', Embo was set to make an appearance during a<ref name="CO 17 AOaUF panel">{{SWYouTube|85Jw-63YNYI|Star Wars Celebration Orlando 2017: Animated Origins and Unexpected Fates}}</ref> four-episode arc<ref name="Michnovetz">{{Twitter|MattMichnovetz|status/341245477838266368|[[Matt Michnovetz]]|quote=You bet!|archivedate=20190904234219|archivefile=File:TCWBountyHunterArc-MichnovetzTwitter.png}} {{C|In response to: "Thanks Matt. Is your bounty hunter arc with Boba Fett, Cad Bane, & Aurra Sing a 4-episode arc too? Plz reply"}}</ref> starring Boba Fett and Cad Bane. In a clip revealed during the "Animated Origins and Unexpected Fates" panel at [[Celebration Orlando]] in [[2017]], Embo and Bossk were seen siding with Bane during a stand-off against Fett and other bounty hunters, with the Kyuzo dropping Sugi's [[EE-3 carbine rifle]] and his Anooba Marrok was also going to drop her knife. While Bossk betrayed Bane by suggesting giving Fett a chance to prove himself, Embo's was just sitting idle, abandoning Bane to his fate.<ref name="CO 17 AOaUF panel" /> Early concept art of a scene featuring Embo and the other bounty hunters walking down a street was done by Filoni during one of the last writer's conferences.<ref name="Thank">{{SW|url=news/to-fans-of-star-wars-the-clone-wars-thank-you|text=To Fans of ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Thank You}}</ref>

Embo was depicted on the walls of the ''Ghost'' in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'',<ref name="Fighter Flight" /> with the room having been designed by Embo's original designer, Pat Presley.<ref name="Presley IG Ghost">{{Instagram|username=phattro|name=[[Pat Presley]]|url=p/CvAlZeqRymq|date=2023-07-22|quote=Star Wars Rebels - The Ghost Living Quarters (swipe to see more) More ship interior concept art. Personal quarters for our ladies of The Ghost, Sabine Wren and Hera Syndulla. They are essentially same space being re-designed to fit their style, personality and functionality. Sabine's for her youthful energy and graffiti artist, while Hera's is a combination of her Twi'lek cultural root and pilot/mechanic lifestyle. From the look of it, I think Sabine is a legit Embo fan. 🤓😏|archivefile=File:PatPresley-GhostRooms2-Instagram.png}}</ref> Embo will make his live-action debut in the upcoming [[2026]] film ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu]]'',<ref name="TMaG Trailer2" /> directed by [[Jon Favreau]] and produced<ref name="TMaG Trailer2 SWcom">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-trailer-key-art-2|text=Pedro Pascal Stars in New Trailer for ''The Mandalorian and Grogu''}}</ref> and co-written by Filoni,<ref name="WGA">{{WebCite|url=https://directories.wga.org/project/1280591/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu|text=Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu|date=2026-02-17|work=[[Wikipedia:Writer's Guild of America West|Writer's Guild of America West]]|archivedate=20260312045124}}</ref> and was first shown in it's second public teaser in February of that year.<ref name="TMaG Trailer2 SWcom" /> Some of the character's gear in the film was designed by [[Patrick Beals]]. After watching the trailer, Pat Presley shared on social media that he was suprised and excited to see Embo return and had always wondered if the character would ever appear in live-action.<ref name="Presley IG" />

===Other appearances===
Embo was added to the [[Star Wars video games|mobile video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'', developed by [[EA Capital Games]], on [[August 9]], [[2018]],<ref name="GoH Trailer">{{EASWYouTube|BNEqeVwi9nU|Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes - Embo has Arrived}}</ref> with his introductory "Marquee event" designed by [[Mike Profeta]].<ref name="Profeta">{{WebCite|url=https://www.mikeprofeta.com/star-wars-galaxy-of-heroes|text=STAR WARS™: Galaxy of Heroes|work=[[Mike Profeta]]'s website|archivedate=20250926120650}}</ref>
